literature.citation: Bauer, M. (2026), The Real-World Economic Impact of the Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA), ECIPE Occasional Paper 08/2026
literature.title: The Real-World Economic Impact of the Cloud and AI Development Act (CADA): What CADA Could Mean for Cloud Prices, Migration, Digitalisation and Europe's Technology Supply Chain
literature.method: cost estimate of the proposal over 2027-2036, adding costs not monetised in the Commission impact assessment (re-architecting, migration, supply shortages)
literature.headline: Application re-architecting and code rewriting, left out of the Commission's monetised costs, is the largest cost driver at nearly 70% of total economic exposure; there is no broad European supply base able to meet the highest sovereignty levels at scale.
